resources.title: Git and GitHub for Beginners - Crash Course

practice_tasks: Initialize a local Git repository, create a branch, make commits, push to GitHub, and open a pull request.
Complete lessons 1 through 10 on SQLBolt and write 5 custom queries joining two tables.

resources.title: freeCodeCamp Data Structures and Algorithms in Python

practice_tasks: Study Big-O notation, arrays, and strings.
Solve 5 easy problems on LeetCode focusing on arrays and hash maps (e.g., Two Sum, Valid Anagram).
Complete the Kaggle Pandas course and manipulate a public dataset (handling missing values, grouping, filtering).
Solve 4 algorithm problems involving two pointers and basic sorting.

resources.title: StatQuest with Josh Starmer (Machine Learning Playlist)

practice_tasks: Watch core StatQuest videos on Linear Regression, Logistic Regression, and Decision Trees.
Complete the introductory modules of the Google ML Crash Course regarding loss and gradient descent.

resources.title: Kaggle Intro to Machine Learning Course

practice_tasks: Build a complete Scikit-Learn pipeline using a tabular dataset to train a classification model.
Evaluate the model using accuracy, precision, recall, and a confusion matrix.
Complete the PyTorch Tensors and autograd tutorials, building a basic neural network for dummy data.
Solve 3 easy/medium tree or graph traversal problems (e.g., Maximum Depth of Binary Tree).
